sections.heading: C2 — Alcohol, drugs and impaired-driving consequences
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Alcohol, drugs and impaired-driving consequences

FACT_ID: sec16-R01 | anchor: A128
The source identifies an SR-twenty-two as an insurer's certified statement of liability coverage used as proof of financial responsibility. [A128]
Source: [A128 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0128]

FACT_ID: sec16-R02 | anchor: A128
The handbook requires one year of financial-responsibility proof for a first violation of Idaho's no-insurance law. [A128]
Source: [A128 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0128]

FACT_ID: sec16-R03 | anchor: A128
For a second no-insurance offense within five years, the source requires financial-responsibility proof for three years. [A128]
Source: [A128 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0128]

FACT_ID: sec16-R04 | anchor: A132
The general adult first-DUI-conviction list gives up to six months in jail and a fine up to one thousand dollars. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R05 | anchor: A132
That general adult first-conviction list gives a mandatory suspension from ninety through one hundred eighty days, with no driving in its first thirty days. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R06 | anchor: A132
For a second adult conviction within ten years, the general list gives mandatory jail from ten days through one year and a fine up to two thousand dollars. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R07 | anchor: A132
The general adult second-conviction list requires a one-year license suspension when the second conviction is within ten years. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R08 | anchor: A132
For an adult's third or later conviction within ten years, the general list gives mandatory jail from thirty days to ten years and a fine up to five thousand dollars. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R09 | anchor: A132
The same adult third-or-later conviction carries the source's mandatory one-through-five-year suspension and felony classification. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R10 | anchor: A132
The printed under-twenty-one suspension parentheticals give one year for a first conviction and two years for a second within ten years. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R11 | anchor: A132
For an under-twenty-one third or later conviction within ten years, the printed suspension is one year or until age twenty-one, whichever is longer. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R12 | anchor: A132
During a traffic stop, remain calm, signal and pull off or aside as soon as safely possible. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R13 | anchor: A132
After stopping for an officer, switch off the engine and radio, remain inside unless told to exit and keep the hands visible on the steering wheel. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R14 | anchor: A132
The traffic-stop guidance says neither the driver nor passengers should use phones or mobile devices during the encounter. [A132]
Source: [A132 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0132]

FACT_ID: sec16-R15 | anchor: A133
Tell the officer at first contact if a weapon is in the vehicle. [A133]
Source: [A133 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0133]

FACT_ID: sec16-R16 | anchor: A133
An officer may request the license, insurance proof and registration; if they are out of reach, explain their location before reaching. [A133]
Source: [A133 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0133]

FACT_ID: sec16-R17 | anchor: A133
If directed to leave the vehicle, remain clear of traffic and keep hands plainly visible. [A133]
Source: [A133 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0133]

FACT_ID: sec16-R18 | anchor: A133
An officer may conclude a stop with a warning or ticket; a ticket can include a fine and may be contested in court. [A133]
Source: [A133 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0133]

FACT_ID: sec16-R19 | anchor: A133
The source says signing and accepting a traffic ticket does not admit guilt, while refusing to sign may lead to arrest. [A133]
Source: [A133 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0133]

FACT_ID: sec16-R20 | anchor: A133
Report perceived officer misconduct promptly to the agency; the ticket lists identifying information, which may also be requested from the officer. [A133]
Source: [A133 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0133]

ranked.label: Distinguish insurance proof and conditional sanctions

corpus_stability.reason: Corpus is the frozen July handbook snapshot; future issuer changes require a new source registration, rather than silent updates to this corpus.

verification_debt.claim_text: The serious-offense financial-responsibility condition begins on physical page one hundred twenty-seven and continues onto one hundred twenty-eight. The complete suspension-triggered three-year requirement needs a multi-page binding; it is not replaced with an unqualified serious-offense rule.

The under-twenty-one parentheticals in the general criminal-penalty list on physical page one hundred thirty-two do not establish which BAC branches they cover; the second-conviction jail parenthesis gives thirty days without a clear range relation. Underage jail and fine combinations are withheld pending exact current legal authority rather than inferred from the adult list.

Physical page one hundred thirty-one says an alcohol concentration of at least zero point twenty has stiffer consequences, but the selected criminal-penalty list does not map that enhanced branch. The general adult table is source-described, not a complete sanction calculator.

Physical page one hundred thirty-two says an interlock restriction will likely follow suspension, whereas one hundred twenty-seven says it is required after a DUI conviction unless the court orders otherwise. The modal difference is unresolved; no blanket likelihood or mandatory rule is silently chosen.

The do-not-make-sudden-moves-or-search-documents instruction starts on physical page one hundred thirty-two and completes on one hundred thirty-three. That complete negative instruction needs a multi-page binding; locally complete document-location and visible-hand instructions are covered.
Any impairment charts or illustrations associated with the mapped pages have not received semantic image review. No image-derived risk curve or visual practice item is authored.
